theme_concept: Premium Global Trade Infrastructure. Think Stripe or Linear meets Financial Times / premium jewellery brand aesthetic. Highly editorial, operational, and credible enough for a YC partner or international luxury brand.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large marketing copy, dashboard main titles. Use tracking-tight (-0.02em to -0.04em) for large sizes.

body.usage: Paragraphs, table data, forms, standard UI elements. Clean, modern, highly legible.

labels_mono.usage: SKUs, order IDs, timestamps, small operational labels in uppercase. Adds technical/operational credibility.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces only. No glassmorphism. Avoid excessive rounded corners (max rounded-md or rounded-sm).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders (border-default) to define sections. Use grid-borders for data-heavy sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle, crisp shadows for dropdowns and dialogs. Example: shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(28,27,26,0.08)]. Marketing cards should mostly rely on borders, not shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay ONLY on dark hero sections or specific marketing visual blocks. Otherwise, keep it clean.

components_customization.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm) solid rectangles. Primary: Dark charcoal bg (#1C1B1A) with off-white text, OR Bronze (#A38057) with white text. Hover states should simply darken the background.
components_customization.cards: Minimalist rectangular containers with 1px border (#E6E2D8) and solid white background. No default shadows.
components_customization.inputs: Square or rounded-sm with 1px borders. Generous padding. Focus state should use a crisp charcoal ring (ring-gray-900).
components_customization.tables: Editorial and elegant. Lots of whitespace. Border-b only for rows (no vertical borders). Text size text-sm with Manrope. Align numbers to the right. Use uppercase small mono font for column headers.
components_customization.tabs: Underline style preferred over pill style. Use bronze or dark charcoal for the active indicator.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for container padding. Spacing system follows Tailwind scale.
grids_and_layouts.marketing: Asymmetrical editorial grids, overlapping images, large typography leading the eye. High white-space ratio.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: Dense but clear. Strict grid hierarchy. F-pattern for forms. Sidebar should be clean, using subtle off-white background (#F2EFE9).

motion.interactions: Subtle background color changes on hover, swift fade-ins. Avoid bouncy or springy animations. Use standard ease-in-out.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially bronze accents on light backgrounds, meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: Clear, visible focus rings on all inputs/buttons.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="submit-rfq-button").

media.guidelines: High-quality, authentic jewellery, workshop, and shipping imagery. No cartoon illustrations. Full bleed in hero, or tightly framed in bento grids.
media.overlay: If text is over an image, use a subtle linear-gradient overlay from black/40 to transparent.

hero.description: Silver diamond studded ring, premium feel.
Silver and blue gemstone pendant necklace.

logistics.description: Aerial view of container ship for logistics/export section.

icons.style: Light or Thin weights for a premium, delicate look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Old Money Tech / Editorial Future theme.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing pages. Avoid standard Shadcn cards there to maintain a bespoke editorial feel.
For the dashboards, heavily customize Shadcn to remove generic Vercel looks. Use flat borders, right-aligned numbers in tables, and muted colors.
AVOID: purple/blue AI gradients, excessive border radius, glassmorphism, crypto-vibes.
Use Cormorant Garamond for Headings and Manrope for body text. Add IBM Plex Mono for small data points/SKUs.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Always ensure clear surfaces under floating elements.
Provide clear YC demo mode indicators in the Admin dashboard using clean labels.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
For the Buyer/Exporter dashboards, ensure the sidebar navigation is clean, utilizing the subtle off-white background.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (using borders and subtle solid dropshadows, not blurs).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like crisp rectangles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text for images.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.
